headline: Fighting Rekindles on Stlican Shelf as Stonecradle Clashes Grind On
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, fresh instability has broken out across the eastern and central corridors, headlined by renewed base captures in Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm. Stlican Shelf surged back to life with five rapid base transitions over the past two hours centered on Breaker Town alongside accelerating enlistments, while Palantine Berm logged three fresh swings up to the wire around Vendett and Windburn Landing. In Stonecradle, the brutal contest continues with three further changes of possession and more than twenty-one hundred casualties in two hours. Linn of Mercy has seen territorial exchanges pause for the moment, yet attrition remains staggering with over four thousand combined dead in the same two-hour span. Meanwhile, several previously active sectors have quieted: Farranac Coast has slowed to a crawl with negligible losses, and both Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow recorded no base exchanges during the latest watch, even as Nevish Line endured a sharp localized spike in casualties.
